title: Mannen som slutade röka
actors: Gösta Ekman, Grynet Molvig, Toivo Pawlo
plot: Young Dante Alighieri inherits 17 million from his father the sausage maker on one condition - he has to give up smoking in 14 days. But the days go on and he simply can't quit. He hires a detective agency to physically stop him. ...
